name: ExpandALVHierarchicalTable
label: Expand ALV Hierarchical Table
description: Expands a row in an SAP ALV Hierarchical Table by clicking the expansion icon.

fields.name: WindowTitle
fields.label: Window Title
fields.description: Title of the SAP GUI window (e.g., 'SAP Logon').

fields.name: RowIndex
fields.label: Row Index
fields.description: Zero-based index of the row to expand.

fields.name: ContinueOnError
fields.label: Continue on Error
fields.description: If true, workflow continues even if the request fails.
